_readme: PUBLIC deliverables only. Documents will be published as PDF files after approval by the consortium.

deliverables.title: Project Management & Quality Assurance Plan
deliverables.description: Comprehensive governance structure, KPI framework, risk register, and quality assurance procedures for project execution.

deliverables.title: External Advisory Committee Terms of Reference
deliverables.description: Terms of reference, mandate, composition, and evaluation guidelines for the independent External Advisory Committee (EAC).

deliverables.title: Final External Evaluation & Impact Assessment
deliverables.description: Independent evaluation validating overall project achievements, sustainability, and alignment with Erasmus+ CBHE objectives.

deliverables.title: Competence Framework Report
deliverables.description: Shared European-aligned ICT competence framework integrating AI, green computing, sustainability, and ethics (DigComp & GreenComp).

deliverables.title: Curriculum & Micro-credential Package
deliverables.description: Modular curriculum updates and 10 ECTS MOOC-based certificate package (5 micro-credentials × 2 ECTS) in sustainable and ethical ICT.

deliverables.title: Redesigned Internship Model & Guidelines
deliverables.description: AI-resilient, competence-based dual-education internship model, supervision guidelines, and learning agreements.

deliverables.title: Academic Staff Training Toolkit & Report
deliverables.description: Training toolkit and completion report covering at least 120 trained academic staff and industry mentors across partner countries.

deliverables.title: Industry Mentor Training Guidelines & Report
deliverables.description: Supervision guidelines, workplace mentoring rubrics, and participation report for trained industry supervisors.

deliverables.title: Institutional Readiness & Adaptation Package
deliverables.description: Institutional guidelines, credit recognition policies, and QA procedures approved across Partner Country HEIs.

deliverables.title: WP3 Capacity Building Completion Report
deliverables.description: Final synthesis of capacity building achievements, participant reach, and handover documentation for pilot implementation.

deliverables.title: Pilot Implementation Report
deliverables.description: Comprehensive report on curriculum and internship pilot delivery, student enrolment statistics, and assessment outcomes.

deliverables.title: Internship Case Studies & Good Practices
deliverables.description: 10–15 anonymized internship case studies and good practices guide on inclusive supervision and competence alignment.

deliverables.title: WP4 Pilot Evaluation & Impact Summary
deliverables.description: Evaluation summary analyzing graduate readiness, employer satisfaction, and student feedback across all pilot streams.

deliverables.title: Final Internal Monitoring & Evaluation Report
deliverables.description: Full project internal evaluation analyzing achievement of objectives, CBHE indicators, pilot results, and inclusion metrics.

deliverables.title: WP5 Quality & Evaluation Synthesis
deliverables.description: Short synthesis report detailing key lessons learned, recommendations, and handover to project closure.

deliverables.title: Project Website & Initial Communication Materials
deliverables.description: Fully functional project website, brand identity, project flyer, and multilingual communication kit.

deliverables.title: Interim Dissemination & Exploitation Report
deliverables.description: Progress report tracking communication outreach, website traffic, stakeholder engagement, and initial uptake.

deliverables.title: Open Educational Resources (OER) Package
deliverables.description: Public release of selected micro-credential modules, toolkits, and training guidelines under open licenses.

deliverables.title: Sustainability & Exploitation Plan
deliverables.description: Roadmap and signed partner agreements ensuring long-term institutional continuation of curricula and internship models.

deliverables.title: Final Dissemination & Impact Summary
deliverables.description: Summary of all dissemination and exploitation activities, event outreach, stakeholder feedback, and overall impact.
